tokens.name: brand-navy
tokens.usage: Logo navy, exact. The mark, the wordmark and brand moments only; UI text uses `ink`.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Logo teal, exact. The center bar of the mark. In the UI it appears as `accent`.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background behind panels and the project grid.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, the chat panel and modals. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent-text`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Sidebar, transcript side panel and table header rows. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: brand-panel
tokens.usage: Brand-colored panels: the sign-in side panel and the cover slab. White text and the reverse logos sit on it. Lighter than navy in dark mode so it stays visible.

tokens.name: on-brand-panel
tokens.usage: Text and marks on `brand-panel` (16.7:1 light, 12.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and panels. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox outlines. At least 3:1 on `surface` and `canvas`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`, `accent-soft` and `highlight`. Also the focus ring (2px, solid).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: timestamps, expert titles, metadata. On `canvas`, `surface`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand teal fill: primary buttons, the active nav marker, the verified-quote badge. Text on it is `on-accent` (navy), never white.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `accent` fills. Text: `on-accent`.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Teal as text: links, "Verified" labels, active tab labels. On `surface`, `canvas` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected table rows, active filters and the chat assistant bubble. Text: `ink` or `accent-text`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent` and `accent-strong` fills (navy, 5.4:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Background behind a found quote in the transcript panel. Text: `ink`.

tokens.name: recording
tokens.usage: The live-recording dot and destructive actions (delete transcript, close project). As text, on `surface`.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Reference for the wordmark in the logo files (Plus Jakarta Sans Bold, -4%). Use the logo files, not live text, wherever the logo appears.

styles.name: wordmark-manrope
styles.usage: Alternate wordmark spec (Manrope Bold, -4.5%). Not used by the current logo files.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: Former VP Network Ops, regional carrier

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Search across every call in this project.

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: "We lost about a third of our enterprise accounts to fiber overbuilders in two years."
styles.usage: Verbatim quotes in search results and the chat panel. Serif marks text as the expert's exact words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls and between table cells.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, quote highlights, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Waveform bars and pill-shaped status chips, echoing the bars in the mark.
